priorities.summary: OpenPanel js-runtime (through commit bad75bdd) has a sandbox escape in its JavaScript webhook template validator: computed member access reaches the Function constructor, letting an attacker with project write access execute arbitrary code in the shared worker process.

IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 vulnerability batch (disclosed 19 Sep 2026) — CVE-2026-84064 is the highest-scoring of four 9.9 CVEs covering unauthenticated RCE, SQL injection and authentication bypass with no confirmed exploitation yet.
Synology-SA-26:13 (18 Sep 2026): improper encoding/escaping in SCGI in DiskStation Manager lets remote attackers read or write arbitrary files and trigger denial of service on unpatched NAS devices.

model.name: TypeSafe AI — Jev (System One Models)
model.summary: TypeSafe AI broke two years of stealth on Sep 15 with Jev, the first "System One" model — a decision engine that returns typed, calibrated outputs instead of chat text, aimed at 100x-faster structured automation decisions at $0.042/M input tokens. Founded by ex-OpenAI RLHF/InstructGPT co-author Diogo Almeida, the launch came with a $40M DCVC-led seed round.
